reported_issue: #constructor: 'The graphics device is not yet created at this point'
edit: In CNA the base Game constructor has already built the GraphicsDevice (the renderer and, for a windowed renderer, the window) before your constructor body runs, but the manager's preferences (size, profile, presentation mode) are only applied later, when the game initialises just before Initialize(), so do not rely on them being in effect in the constructor.

reported_issue: #gamewindow: 'the native window itself is created when Run() is called'
edit: for any renderer that needs a window, the native window is already created during Game construction, so getClientBoundsProperty() can be queried from a derived constructor, although the manager's preferred size is only applied when the game initialises, just before Initialize() runs.
evidence: modules/graphics/src/Xna/GraphicsDevice.cpp (createOrAttachWindow via resolveRenderer in the constructor); modules/runtime/src/Game.cpp (Window_.setWindowInternal in constructor); modules/runtime/src/GameWindow.cpp (getClientBoundsProperty queries the platform window when window_ != nullptr)

reported_issue: #textinputext note: StartTextInput/StopTextInput 'have no visible effect' on desktop
edit: Text input is a mode, not a no-op on desktop: on Win32, for example, the event mapper consumes every WM_CHAR without raising a TextInput event until the window's mode has been enabled by StartTextInput(), and the mapper's own source comment says a game that never called it sees the same on every other backend. Call StartTextInput() before you expect TextInput events.
evidence: modules/platform/src/Win32/Win32EventMapper.cpp (TranslateChar: if(!textInputActive_) return true; SetTextInputActive); Win32EventMapper.hpp (SetTextInputActive comment); Win32InputServices.cpp (Win32TextInput::Start); IPlatformTextInput.hpp ('Text input is a mode')

reported_issue: Invalid CNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER 'throws once on the first query; build default applies afterwards'
edit: The variable is read once, on the first query, and in our reading of the code that first query is made before main() (registry namespace-scope initialiser -> PublishAvailable -> RebuildAttemptOrder -> GetSelected -> ConsultEnvironmentOnce). A bad value (or one naming a renderer that is not compiled in), like an invalid Module.cnaPreferredRenderer page property, therefore cannot be caught by game code and ends the process through std::terminate; the build default does not apply afterwards. Derived from reading the source, not executed.
evidence: cmake/templates/CnaRendererRegistry.generated.cpp.in (cnaRendererRegistryPublished namespace-scope lambda); modules/core/src/GraphicsRendererSelection.cpp (PublishAvailable sets published=true then RebuildAttemptOrder -> GetSelected -> ConsultEnvironmentOnce throws; RejectIfNotCompiledIn)
